name: dAVEBOx SA
description: An 8-track MIDI sequencer for Ableton Move that runs as its own session, launched from Schwung: Move restarts into dAVEBOx, playing Move's instruments and the modules you installed in Schwung. The successor to dAVEBOx. Install it here, then open dAVEBOx SA from the Tools menu: the first launch finishes the install by itself. Stock Schwung is untouched and comes back when you quit.
